summary: A valley is a low passage through which the shepherd leads safely.

senses.definition: Though I walk through a valley of death-shadow, I fear no evil.

note:
Drafted for Psalms 21–30; some homographic names remain separate.

Root (2026-11-21): Filed under its own consonants גיא as a reconstructed root (the spelling גַּי / גֵּי shows the א may drop): no verb or cognate root is known for 'valley'.
